description: Desktop notifications for AI agents and other tools that can run hooks, including inside Dev Containers.
config.enabled: Watch the inbox and show desktop notifications.
config.inboxPath: Folder to use as the local inbox. Leave empty to use the extension's storage folder provided by VS Code.
config.presets: Named notifications that a hook can send with `{"preset":"<name>"}`. The built-in `done`, `waiting`, and `error` can be overridden field by field, and new names can be added.
config.presets.title: Title of the notification.
config.presets.source: Name of the tool, shown below the message.
